sentences.text: If you run a moving belt up a slope, you have an escalator.
But a box on the steep belt slides back down.
So you bolt flat steps onto the belt.
But now the steps tilt with the slope, and the box slides off.
So each step rolls on wheels in two tracks that hold it level, even at 30 degrees.
A motor at the top turns a gear that pulls the steps up.
But if the motor fails, the loaded steps roll back down.
So you add a brake that stops them when the power fails.
Add a handrail and a ceiling light to complete it.
Congratulations, you have built an escalator.
